findings.claim: The existing production `PgGateRepository::connect` constructor is made test-only without any shown production caller migration, risking a non-test build break.
findings.evidence: The hunk changes `impl PgGateRepository { pub async fn connect(url: &str) -> Result<Self, GateError> { ... } }` to `#[cfg(test)] pub async fn connect(...)`, and no diff updates production call sites to use the new `connect_with_document_store`; blocking constraint `build-passes` requires `cargo build --workspace` to compile.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep a production `connect(url)` constructor that supplies the default document store, or update all non-test callers in the same diff to call `connect_with_document_store` with a concrete store.

findings.claim: The case router removes the existing evidence-count endpoint that serialized `met`, `gap`, and `void` distinctly.
findings.evidence: The deleted hunk removes `.route("/api/cases/{case_id}/evidence", get(evidence_counts))` and `EvidenceCountsDto { met, gap, void }`; blocking constraint `three-evidence-states` says evidence state must preserve met, gap, and void as distinct values.
findings.suggested_fix: Retain this route or move an equivalent authenticated route in the same change that still returns distinct `met`, `gap`, and `void` fields.
